## Create similarity scores between TFs

```{r}
library(GOSemSim)
library(dplyr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)

tf_list <- read.delim("/DATA/pipelines/primetime/misc/tf_functions.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(tf) %>%
  mutate(tf = gsub("::.*", "", tf)) %>%
  pull(tf)

semData <- godata(org.Hs.eg.db, ont = "BP", keytype = "SYMBOL")

tf_sim <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(tf_list), ncol = length(tf_list),
                 dimnames = list(tf_list, tf_list))

for (i in seq_along(tf_list)) {
    for (j in i:length(tf_list)) {
        val <- tryCatch({
            geneSim(tf_list[i], tf_list[j], semData = semData, measure = "Wang")$geneSim
        }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
        if (length(val) != 1 || is.nan(val)) val <- NA_real_
        tf_sim[i, j] <- val
        tf_sim[j, i] <- val
    }
}


# Map back heterodimers
rename_map <- c("POU5F1.1" = "POU5F1::SOX2",
                "RARA.1"   = "RARA::RXRA",
                "AHR"      = "AHR::ARNT",
                "STAT1.1"  = "STAT1::STAT2",
                "MAF"      = "MAF::NFE2",
                "FOS"      = "FOS::JUN",
                "SMAD2"    = "SMAD2::3::4")


tf_sim_long <- melt(tf_sim, varnames = c("tf1", "tf2"), value.name = "similarity")

tf_sim_long <- tf_sim_long %>%
    mutate(
        tf1 = recode(tf1, !!!rename_map),
        tf2 = recode(tf2, !!!rename_map)
    )


write.csv(tf_sim, file = "/DATA/pipelines/primetime/misc/tf_similarity_gosemsim.csv", quote = FALSE)

```
